query:
SELECT id as "id!: i32", 
account_id as "account_id!: String", 
member_id as "member_id!: String", 
rating as "rating!: CommunityMemberRating", 
collabs as "collabs!: i32", 
rewards as "rewards!: String", 
first_collab_date as "first_collab_date!: Option < UtcDateTime >", 
last_collab_date as "last_collab_date!: Option < UtcDateTime >", 
force_hydrate as "force_hydrate!: bool", 
priority as "priority!: bool", 
alignment as "alignment!: Option < i32 >", 
trust as "trust!: Option < i32 >", 
contribution as "contribution!: Option < i32 >", 
advocacy as "advocacy!: Option < i32 >", 
judgment as "judgment!: Option < i32 >", 
rootstock_joined_at as "rootstock_joined_at!: Option < UtcDateTime >", 
comment as "comment!: Option < String >", 
created_at as "created_at!: UtcDateTime", 
updated_at as "updated_at!: Option < UtcDateTime >" FROM community_members WHERE (NOT $1::boolean OR id = $2::int4) AND (NOT $3::boolean OR id = ANY(CAST($4 as int4[])) ) AND (NOT $5::boolean OR account_id = $6::varchar) AND (NOT $7::boolean OR member_id = $8::varchar) AND (NOT $9::boolean OR rating = $10::community_member_rating) AND (NOT $11::boolean OR collabs = $12::int4) AND (NOT $13::boolean OR rewards = $14::varchar) AND (NOT $15::boolean OR first_collab_date = $16::timestamptz) AND ($17::boolean IS NULL OR (($17::boolean AND first_collab_date IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT $17::boolean AND first_collab_date IS NULL))) AND (NOT $18::boolean OR last_collab_date = $19::timestamptz) AND ($20::boolean IS NULL OR (($20::boolean AND last_collab_date IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT $20::boolean AND last_collab_date IS NULL))) AND (NOT $21::boolean OR force_hydrate = $22::boolean) AND (NOT $23::boolean OR priority = $24::boolean) AND (NOT $25::boolean OR alignment = $26::int4) AND ($27::boolean IS NULL OR (($27::boolean AND alignment IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT $27::boolean AND alignment IS NULL))) AND (NOT $28::boolean OR trust = $29::int4) AND ($30::boolean IS NULL OR (($30::boolean AND trust IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT $30::boolean AND trust IS NULL))) AND (NOT $31::boolean OR contribution = $32::int4) AND ($33::boolean IS NULL OR (($33::boolean AND contribution IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT $33::boolean AND contribution IS NULL))) AND (NOT $34::boolean OR advocacy = $35::int4) AND ($36::boolean IS NULL OR (($36::boolean AND advocacy IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT $36::boolean AND advocacy IS NULL))) AND (NOT $37::boolean OR judgment = $38::int4) AND ($39::boolean IS NULL OR (($39::boolean AND judgment IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT $39::boolean AND judgment IS NULL))) AND (NOT $40::boolean OR rootstock_joined_at = $41::timestamptz) AND ($42::boolean IS NULL OR (($42::boolean AND rootstock_joined_at IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT $42::boolean AND rootstock_joined_at IS NULL))) AND (NOT $43::boolean OR comment = $44::text) AND (NOT $45::boolean OR created_at = $46::timestamptz) AND (NOT $47::boolean OR updated_at = $48::timestamptz) AND ($49::boolean IS NULL OR (($49::boolean AND updated_at IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT $49::boolean AND updated_at IS NULL))) ORDER BY 
      (CASE ($50 = 'Id' AND NOT $51) WHEN true THEN id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($50 = 'Id' AND $51) WHEN true THEN id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($50 = 'AccountId' AND NOT $51) WHEN true THEN account_id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($50 = 'AccountId' AND $51) WHEN true THEN account_id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($50 = 'MemberId' AND NOT $51) WHEN true THEN member_id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($50 = 'MemberId' AND $51) WHEN true THEN member_id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($50 = 'Rating' AND NOT $51) WHEN true THEN rating ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($50 = 'Rating' AND $51) WHEN true THEN rating ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($50 = 'Collabs' AND NOT $51) WHEN true THEN collabs ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($50 = 'Collabs' AND $51) WHEN true THEN collabs ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($50 = 'Rewards' AND NOT $51) WHEN true THEN rewards ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($50 = 'Rewards' AND $51) WHEN true THEN rewards ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($50 = 'FirstCollabDate' AND NOT $51) WHEN true THEN first_collab_date ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($50 = 'FirstCollabDate' AND $51) WHEN true THEN first_collab_date ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($50 = 'LastCollabDate' AND NOT $51) WHEN true THEN last_collab_date ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($50 = 'LastCollabDate' AND $51) WHEN true THEN last_collab_date ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($50 = 'ForceHydrate' AND NOT $51) WHEN true THEN force_hydrate ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($50 = 'ForceHydrate' AND $51) WHEN true THEN force_hydrate ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($50 = 'Priority' AND NOT $51) WHEN true THEN priority ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($50 = 'Priority' AND $51) WHEN true THEN priority ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($50 = 'Alignment' AND NOT $51) WHEN true THEN alignment ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($50 = 'Alignment' AND $51) WHEN true THEN alignment ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($50 = 'Trust' AND NOT $51) WHEN true THEN trust ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($50 = 'Trust' AND $51) WHEN true THEN trust ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($50 = 'Contribution' AND NOT $51) WHEN true THEN contribution ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($50 = 'Contribution' AND $51) WHEN true THEN contribution ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($50 = 'Advocacy' AND NOT $51) WHEN true THEN advocacy ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($50 = 'Advocacy' AND $51) WHEN true THEN advocacy ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($50 = 'Judgment' AND NOT $51) WHEN true THEN judgment ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($50 = 'Judgment' AND $51) WHEN true THEN judgment ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($50 = 'RootstockJoinedAt' AND NOT $51) WHEN true THEN rootstock_joined_at ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($50 = 'RootstockJoinedAt' AND $51) WHEN true THEN rootstock_joined_at ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($50 = 'Comment' AND NOT $51) WHEN true THEN comment ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($50 = 'Comment' AND $51) WHEN true THEN comment ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($50 = 'CreatedAt' AND NOT $51) WHEN true THEN created_at ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($50 = 'CreatedAt' AND $51) WHEN true THEN created_at ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($50 = 'UpdatedAt' AND NOT $51) WHEN true THEN updated_at ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($50 = 'UpdatedAt' AND $51) WHEN true THEN updated_at ELSE NULL END) DESC
     LIMIT $52 OFFSET $53
